relationship_to_v252: Tests the boundary between compensable weakness and critical deficit. One capacity is progressively weakened while the other capacities remain high.

ethical_sense_mechanism.authority: same functional authority family as v251/v252

preregistered_acceptance_checks.monotonic_reliability_decline: for at least 4/5 dimensions, lowering the tested capacity monotonically lowers realized reliability
preregistered_acceptance_checks.critical_threshold_exists: at least 3/5 dimensions cross reliability<0.75 somewhere on the grid
preregistered_acceptance_checks.ATF_or_I_most_sensitive: A_TF or I reaches critical deficit at a higher tested value than at least 2 other dimensions
preregistered_acceptance_checks.high_other_capacities_compensate_moderat: for at least 3/5 dimensions, tested value 0.50 still yields reliability>=0.75
preregistered_acceptance_checks.severe_weakness_not_fully_compensable: for at least 4/5 dimensions, tested value 0.20 yields reliability<0.75
preregistered_acceptance_checks.geometric_transition_band: critical crossings occur with geometric maturity between 0.45 and 0.70
preregistered_acceptance_checks.accuracy_tracks_reliability: Spearman across all conditions between realized reliability and decision_accuracy >=0.85
